# Nomadar to Participate in the 20th Annual LD Micro Main Event


7 Oct, 2026


|[Press Releases](https://investor.nomadar.com/category/press-releases/)


**Marshall, Texas, October 7, 2026** — Nomadar Corp. (“Nomadar” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: NOMA), a Nasdaq-listed global sports, tourism, technology, and experiential infrastructure company, today announced that Joaquin Martin, Nomadar CEO Americas & Board Director, will participate in the LD Micro 20th Annual Main Event taking place at the Luxe Sunset Blvd. Hotel in Los Angeles, CA, on October 20-21, 2026.


Mr. Martin will host a presentation on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, at 11:30 a.m. PT. A webcast of the presentation will be streamed live at the following link:[https://ldmicroevents.com/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=ov6KWzdkxYPGEr8DRRIlDylromLpfRFEYmle0eqfcOGehlu-UzHp1JjDwSb6-dHVSGJ_yaWhY_U0J3woJ1VSG6jD5RSIOg1ChLADlMrIyPs=) (“Track 3”).


Mr. Martin will also be available for one-on-one meetings with investors on Tuesday, October 20th and Wednesday October, 21st. Investors interested in scheduling a meeting should submit a request through the LD Micro conference platform or by emailingNOMAIR@allianceadvisors.com .


**About Nomadar Corp.**


Nomadar Corp. is a Nasdaq-listed company operating at the intersection of sports, tourism, technology, health and experiential infrastructure. The Company develops and operates platforms designed to connect global audiences through high-performance training, youth development, digital education, international programs, sports tourism and large-scale experiential projects.
